name: cc-warehouse
description: The capture plugin for cc-warehouse. It lives in the same repository as the tool it calls, so the hook and the CLI cannot drift apart.

plugins.name: cc-capture
plugins.description: Captures each Claude Code session into cc-warehouse when the session ends. Requires cc-warehouse's `ccw` on PATH (or CCW_BIN): install it with `uv tool install cc-warehouse`. Logs every run to ~/.claude/logs/ccw-hook.log.
